aboutHeadline: A safe place to grow in bachata.
aboutIntro: With us, you get clear teaching, personal feedback, and a warm community – whether you are a beginner or want to develop your technique.
aboutOrigin: Fuego Dance School was started in 2021 by Mikael Deskalou and Irina Kurochkina with a focus on Bachata Sensual, technique, and teaching for all levels.
aboutText1: Fuego Dance School opened its doors in the autumn of 2021, led by Mikael Deskalou and Irina Kurochkina. Our primary focus is Bachata Sensual, which we teach across several levels – catering to everyone, from complete beginners to experienced dancers.
aboutText2: The school is driven by a passion for dance's ability to unite people and express emotions. For us, this is more than just dance steps; it is a place for community, joy, and personal growth. We strive to create a safe, supportive, and inclusive atmosphere where every student feels seen and encouraged.
aboutText3: Whether you want to learn the fundamentals, fine-tune your technique, or simply find a new community, you are warmly welcome to become part of our Fuego family.
uniquePoint1: We use helper instructors in our classes to give you more personal feedback.
uniquePoint2: We place great importance on technique and understanding the core principles of dance.
valueCard1Text: You should feel welcome, seen, and encouraged from your first class.
valueCard2Text: We build the dance step by step with focus on understanding, musicality, and body control.
valueCard3Text: With assistant instructors in class, you get more support and feedback at your level.
studentGoalTitle: Our goal is for you as a student to:
goalPoint1: Feel like part of the Fuego family.
goalPoint2: Experience a safe and welcoming atmosphere.
goalPoint3: Develop your dance technique and self-confidence.
goalPoint4: Become a respectful and musical dancer, regardless of role.

galleryDescription: A glimpse from our studio, our classes, and the moments that make Fuego more than just dance steps.
